name: Winter Team UP !
source:
Let's team up with Degel, Brume or Neon. Three young reindeers registered for the winter games 2024, three stories, three races to win !
With your help, you will run against two rivals, Givre and Cime, for the first place on the podium.

Choose your MC, choose your partner and let's race !

[From [url=https://amigaux-cllb.itch.io/winter-team-up]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
让我们与Degel、Brume或Neon合作。三只年轻驯鹿报名参加2024年冬季运动会，三个故事，三场比赛，共赢！
在你的帮助下，你将与两位竞争对手Givre和Cime争夺领奖台上的第一名。

选择你的MC，选择你的伙伴，让我们一起比赛吧！

[来自[url=https://amigaux-cllb.itch.io/winter-team-up]itch.io[/url]]
